sources.title: aiden-li/so101-act · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Card for act Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) is an imitation-learning method that predicts short action chunks instead of single steps. It learns from teleoperated data and often achieves high success rates. This policy has been trained and pushed to the Hub using LeRobot. See the full documentation at LeRobot Docs.

sources.snippet: Welcome to this workshop on sim-to-real transfer for the SO-101 robot! This repository contains the assets and code to accompany this learning content. The rest of this README will help you setup the environment and ensure everything is installed correctly. You can also use this repo as a basis for trying out your own tasks.

sources.title: Train an SO-101 Robot From Sim-to-Real With NVIDIA Isaac
sources.snippet: You'll train and deploy a vision-language-action (VLA) model to perform unstructured pick-and-place of centrifuge vials into a rack using an SO-101 robot arm - first in sim, where we can iterate quickly and validate behavior, then in reality.
